translations.idiomatic: Yang Minzhi won the emperor's favor and regularly waited on him in the inner quarters.

sentences.zh: 明帝為輔，與王晏、徐孝嗣、王廣之並面請，不聽。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming as regent, together with Wang Yan, Xu Xiaosi, and Wang Guangzhi, all petitioned him in person, but he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming, serving as regent, joined Wang Yan, Xu Xiaosi, and Wang Guangzhi in pleading with the emperor face to face, but he would not heed them.

sentences.zh: 又令蕭諶、坦之固請，皇后與帝同席坐，流涕覆面，謂坦之曰：「楊郎好年少，無罪過，何可枉殺。

translations.literal: They then had Xiao Chen and Tanzhi urgently petition again; the empress sat on the same mat as the emperor, weeping with her face covered, and said to Tanzhi: "Young Master Yang is so youthful and guilty of no crime — how can he be killed unjustly?"
translations.idiomatic: They sent Xiao Chen and Tanzhi to press the matter again; the empress sat beside the emperor, weeping with her face hidden, and told Tanzhi, "Young Master Yang is so young and has done no wrong — how can he be killed in vain?"

sentences.zh: 」坦之耳語於帝曰：「此事別有一意，不可令人聞。

translations.literal: Tanzhi whispered to the emperor: "This matter has another meaning that must not be let out."
translations.idiomatic: Tanzhi whispered to the emperor, "There is another reason for this that must not be overheard."

sentences.zh: 」帝謂皇后為阿奴，曰：「阿奴暫去」。

translations.literal: The emperor called the empress "Little Slave" and said: "Little Slave, withdraw for a moment."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor called the empress "Little Slave" and said, "Little Slave, step aside for a moment."

sentences.zh: 坦之乃曰：「外間並云楊瑉之與皇后有異情，彰聞遐邇。

translations.literal: Tanzhi then said: "Outside all say Yang Minzhi and the empress have an improper relationship, and the report reaches far and near."
translations.idiomatic: Tanzhi then said, "Outside everyone says Yang Minzhi and the empress are lovers, and the story has spread far and wide."

sentences.zh: 」帝不得已，乃為敕。

translations.literal: The emperor had no choice and issued an edict.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, with no way out, issued the edict.

sentences.zh: 坦之馳報明帝，即令建康行刑，而果有敕原之，而瑉之已死。

translations.literal: Tanzhi raced to inform Emperor Ming, who at once ordered Jiankang to carry out the execution; indeed an edict arrived pardoning him, but Minzhi was already dead.
translations.idiomatic: Tanzhi galloped to tell Emperor Ming, who immediately ordered Jiankang to execute him; a pardon did arrive, but Minzhi was already dead.

sentences.zh: 后既淫亂，又與帝相愛褻，故帝恣之。

translations.literal: The empress was both wanton and intimately beloved of the emperor, so he indulged her.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was wanton, yet the emperor loved her deeply and let her have her way.

sentences.zh: 又迎后親戚入宮，嘗賜人百數十萬，以武帝曜靈殿處后家屬。

translations.literal: He also brought the empress's kin into the palace, once bestowing gifts in the hundreds of thousands, and housed her family in Emperor Wu's Yaoling Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He brought her kin into the palace as well, once lavishing gifts worth hundreds of thousands, and lodged her family in Emperor Wu's Yaoling Hall.

sentences.zh: 帝廢，后貶為王妃。

translations.literal: When the emperor was deposed, the empress was demoted to princess consort.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was deposed, the empress was reduced to princess consort.

sentences.zh: 父戢自有傳。

translations.literal: Her father Ji has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: Her father He Ji has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 海陵王妃王紹明

translations.literal: Consort Wang Shaoming of Prince Hailing.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Wang Shaoming of Prince Hailing.

sentences.zh: 海陵王王妃諱韶明，琅邪臨沂人，太常慈之女也。

translations.literal: Consort Wang of Prince Hailing, personal name Shaoming, was a native of Linyi in Langya and the daughter of the grand minister of ceremonies Ci.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Wang of Prince Hailing, whose personal name was Shaoming, came from Linyi in Langya commandery and was the daughter of Wang Ci, grand minister of ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 永明八年，納為臨汝公夫人。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongming she was taken as lady of the Duke of Linru.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Yongming she was taken as lady of the Duke of Linru.

sentences.zh: 郁林王即位，為新安王妃。

translations.literal: When Prince Yulin took the throne she became consort of the Prince of Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Yulin acceded she became consort of the Prince of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 延興元年，為皇后。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yanxing she became empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanxing she was made empress.

sentences.zh: 其年，降為海陵王妃。

translations.literal: That same year she was demoted to consort of the Prince of Hailing.
translations.idiomatic: That same year she was reduced to consort of the Prince of Hailing.

sentences.zh: 妃父慈自有傳。

translations.literal: The consort's father Ci has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: Her father Wang Ci has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 明敬皇后劉惠端

translations.literal: Empress Mingjing Liu Huiduan.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Mingjing Liu Huiduan.

sentences.zh: 明敬劉皇后諱惠端，彭城人，光祿大夫道弘孫也。

translations.literal: Empress Mingjing of the Liu clan, personal name Huiduan, was a native of Pengcheng and a granddaughter of Grand Master for Splendid Happiness Daohong.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Mingjing of the Liu clan, whose personal name was Huiduan, came from Pengcheng and was a granddaughter of Liu Daohong, grand master for splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 高帝為明帝納之。

translations.literal: Emperor Gao took her in marriage for Emperor Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gao arranged her marriage to Emperor Ming.

sentences.zh: 建元三年，除西昌侯夫人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyuan she was appointed lady of the Marquis of Xichang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jianyuan she was made lady of the Marquis of Xichang.

sentences.zh: 永明七年卒，葬江乘縣張山。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongming she died and was buried at Mount Zhang in Jiangcheng county.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yongming she died and was buried at Mount Zhang in Jiangcheng county.

sentences.zh: 延興元年，贈宣城王妃。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yanxing she was posthumously granted the title princess consort of Xuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanxing she was posthumously made princess consort of Xuancheng.

sentences.zh: 明帝即位，追尊敬皇后。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming took the throne, he posthumously honored her as empress.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming acceded, he posthumously honored her as empress.

sentences.zh: 贈父通直郎景猷為金紫光祿大夫，母王氏平陽鄉君。

translations.literal: Her father Jingyou, palace attendant, was granted the post of grand master of the golden seal and purple cord; her mother Lady Wang was made lady of Pingyang township.
translations.idiomatic: Her father Liu Jingyou, a palace attendant, was raised to grand master of the golden seal and purple cord; her mother Lady Wang was enfeoffed as lady of Pingyang township.

sentences.zh: 明帝崩，改葬，祔于興安陵。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming died, she was reburied and enshrined beside him at Xing'an tomb.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming died, she was reburied and laid beside him at Xing'an tomb.

sentences.zh: 東昏侯皇后褚令璩

translations.literal: Empress Donghun Chu Lingqu.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Donghun Chu Lingqu.

sentences.zh: 東昏褚皇后諱令璩，河南陽翟人，太常澄之女也。

translations.literal: Empress Donghun of the Chu clan, personal name Lingqu, was a native of Yangdi in Henan and the daughter of the grand minister of ceremonies Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Donghun of the Chu clan, whose personal name was Lingqu, came from Yangdi in Henan commandery and was the daughter of Chu Cheng, grand minister of ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 建武二年，納為皇太子妃而無寵。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianwu she was taken as crown princess but received no favor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianwu she was taken as crown princess but won no favor.

sentences.zh: 帝謂左右曰：「若得如山陰主無恨矣。

translations.literal: The emperor said to those around him: "If only I could have the Lady of Shanyin — then I would have no regrets."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his attendants, "If only I could have the Lady of Shanyin — then I would want for nothing."

sentences.zh: 」山陰主，明帝長女也，後遂與之為亂。

translations.literal: The Lady of Shanyin was Emperor Ming's eldest daughter; afterward he carried on an affair with her.
translations.idiomatic: The Lady of Shanyin was Emperor Ming's eldest daughter; afterward he took her as his lover.

sentences.zh: 明年，妃謁敬后廟。

translations.literal: The following year the consort paid homage at the temple of the reverent empress.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the consort paid homage at the temple of Empress Mingjing.

sentences.zh: 東昏即位，為皇后。

translations.literal: When Donghun took the throne she became empress.
translations.idiomatic: When Donghun acceded she was made empress.

sentences.zh: 帝寵潘妃，后不被遇，黃淑儀生太子誦而卒，東昏廢，后及誦並為庶人。

translations.literal: The emperor favored Consort Pan; the empress received no attention. Virtuous Lady of the Yellow bore Crown Prince Song and died; when Donghun was deposed, the empress and Song were both made commoners.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor doted on Consort Pan and neglected the empress. Virtuous Lady of the Yellow bore Crown Prince Song and died; when Donghun was deposed, the empress and Song were both reduced to commoners.

sentences.zh: 后父澄自有傳。

translations.literal: The empress's father Cheng has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: Her father Chu Cheng has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 和王皇后王蕣華

translations.literal: Empress Wang of Prince He.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wang of Prince He.

sentences.zh: 和王皇后諱蕣華，琅邪臨沂人，太尉儉之孫也。

translations.literal: Empress Wang of Prince He, personal name Sunhua, was a native of Linyi in Langya and a granddaughter of the grand marshal Jian.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wang of Prince He, whose personal name was Sunhua, came from Linyi in Langya commandery and was a granddaughter of Wang Jian, grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 初為隨王妃，中興元年為皇后。

translations.literal: At first she was consort of the Prince of Sui; in the first year of Zhongxing she became empress.
translations.idiomatic: At first she was consort of the Prince of Sui; in the first year of Zhongxing she was made empress.

sentences.zh: 帝禪位，后降為妃。

translations.literal: When the emperor abdicated the throne, the empress was demoted to consort.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor abdicated, the empress was reduced to consort.

sentences.zh: 妃祖儉自有傳。

translations.literal: The consort's grandfather Jian has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: Her grandfather Wang Jian has a separate biography.
